items.prompt: A summer evening in a Saint Petersburg courtyard in the late 1990s: a loose crowd of young people, mostly guys with a couple of girls, standing and talking in small groups, some holding beer, seen at a distance. Tall old buildings around, white-night light.

alt.ru: Летний вечер в питерском дворе конца 1990-х: компания молодых людей, в основном парни и пара девушек, стоит кучками с пивом, белая ночь.
alt.en: A summer evening in a Saint Petersburg courtyard in the late 1990s: a crowd of young people, mostly guys and a couple of girls, standing in groups with beer, white-night light.
alt.pt: Um fim de tarde de verão num pátio de São Petersburgo no fim dos anos 90: jovens, sobretudo rapazes e duas raparigas, em grupos com cerveja, luz de noite branca.
alt.es: Una tarde de verano en un patio de San Petersburgo a finales de los noventa: jóvenes, sobre todo chicos y un par de chicas, en grupos con cerveza, luz de noche blanca.
